name: Nazi Lowriders
description: A white supremacist prison gang originating in the California Youth Authority in the mid-to-late 1970s, active both in prison and on the streets primarily in Southern California. Recognized as a gang by California prison authorities in 1999. Known for extreme violence, drug trafficking, and a hierarchical structure. Allied with the Aryan Brotherhood, Mexican Mafia, and Public Enemy No. 1; rivals include Bloods, Crips, and Black Guerrilla Family.

sources.title: Nazi Low Riders Boast Over 1,000 Members, Most in Prison — SPLC
